channel.title: Cote d'Ivoire - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cote d'Ivoire, every source cited.

item.title: Addah village ends 12-year succession crisis
item.description: Roger Sangahi installed as chief, aiming to restore community cohesion after years of division.

item.title: Ivory Coast MP to honour teachers for peace efforts
item.description: Oumé MP Flore Kouassi Lago announced a tribute day for teachers who promoted coexistence during the 2025 presidential election.

item.title: Ivory Coast potato imports climb 45% to $12.5 million
item.description: Demand for fresh and frozen potatoes rises as domestic production meets only a fraction of consumption needs.

item.title: Ivory Coast improves governance ranking
item.description: The nation rose 10 places in the Ibrahim Index of African Governance 2026, reaching 17th position.
